title: Native immutable-image ELF execution manifest input
description: Data only, not execution permission. Exact canonical ASCII JSON with no LF, at most 32768 bytes. A distinct signed start authority must select this original; runtime admission retains actual descriptors under the original clock. The old never-exec launch manifest and static custody contracts are unchanged.

rootfs.description: Three distinct protected host paths. Actual root, loop block and fs-verity image association is observed, not inferred from these strings. Full image is 4096-byte-block baseline single-device EROFS, at most 64 GiB; device tables, chunk devices, extension slots and unknown image features are refused. No ambient submounts are copied.

entry.description: Actual in-image ELF64 entry, at most 16 MiB, host x86_64 or aarch64 architecture. Null interpreter requires no PT_INTERP and no DT_NEEDED. A nonnull interpreter requires exactly one equal PT_INTERP path and a separately held, pinned compatible loader. Direct scripts are not entries; an admitted in-image interpreter ELF may receive a signed script argv.

argv.description: argv[0] must equal entry.path. Each item is at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes with no NUL. argv plus environment including NULs and equals separators is at most 16384 bytes; byte and cross-field bounds are enforced by the owner, not by character-count schema validation.

environment.description: The complete explicit environment; no inherited values. Loader override keys LD_* and GLIBC_TUNABLES are outside this profile. Values are bounded original input and are never logged or treated as authority.

cwd.description: Explicit directory inside the same immutable root; no ambient cwd is inherited.

path.description: Canonical absolute visible-ASCII spelling, at most 64 nonempty components each at most 255 bytes; no backslash, dot or dotdot. In-image symlinks may resolve only within the retained root and without crossing mounts. Host originals are opened component by component without following symlinks.
